headline: Trump Says Iran Will Get Hit 'Very Hard' Tonight, But What Do Prediction Markets Say About The Ceasefire?
summary: Trump vows to take "total control" of Iran's Kharg Island oil hub as military strikes resume. See how prediction markets and oil traders are pricing the risk.

headline: Why's Gold Going Down? This Strategist Called The Drop Before It Happened
summary: Gold slid below 4,100 as the Iran war reignited, abandoning its safe-haven role. An APMEX strategist saw it coming, and prediction markets say why.
